  • 5–7 seats

  • Low range, diff lock

If your route includes Ushguli or Omalo, the Prado is the car we recommend first. With 220 mm of clearance, low-range gearing and a locking differential it is fully cleared for the gravel road up the Enguri valley and for the Abano Pass into Tusheti — a route that opens roughly from June to October, needs written agreement in advance and carries an additional excess.

The 2.8 diesel is why people take it for two-week trips: about 9.5 l/100 km for a body this size, and enough range to remove the worry of a village filling station being closed. Seven seats when you need them, four suitcases once the rear row is folded.

  • Full-time 4WD, low range, differential lock
  • Deposit 1,200 ₾, minimum driver age 25
  • Winter tyres fitted from December to April

At 330 ₾ a day it carries the highest rate in the fleet, but for the high mountains it is the vehicle on which the insurance actually applies. Route conditions are on Terms.
